name: Three Finger Show Desktop
description:
Adds a touchpad gesture that GNOME does not provide: show the desktop with a 3-finger swipe down on the normal desktop (Wayland, GNOME 50).

* Swipe down slowly: windows animate toward the screen edge in sync with your fingers; release early to cancel
* Swipe down fully: show the desktop; swipe down again to restore
* Swipe up is unchanged: only downward 3-finger swipes are captured; Overview and the app grid still use the stock up gesture
* No panel icon and no Quick Settings entry
